profile.headline: SWE @ DoorDash | Cloud Microservices | Java, Kafka, AWS, Docker, Postgres | Led API Development for Front-End | On-Prem to Cloud Migration | Database Sync Between On-Prem & Cloud
profile.summary: Experienced Undergraduate Research Fellow with a demonstrated history of working in the higher education industry. Skilled in Python (Programming Language), Computer Science, C++, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Visual Recognition, and Java. Strong research professional with a Bachelor's degree focused in Computer Science from Georgia Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented large-scale distributed cloud microservices with Java and Kafka messaging services to build parallel processing, increasing scalability and reducing processing time by 40%.
- Redesigned data architecture by decoupling data and consolidating 16 tables into 6, reducing total columns by half, saving 25GB of cloud storage.
- Reduced API response time for internal company website from over 30 seconds to under 3 seconds by optimizing indexes for filter criteria.
- Streamlined cloud validation processes by implementing new event notifications in AWS CloudWatch, eliminating 60% of daily validation and accuracy cron jobs.
- Achieved 100% code coverage on automated testing for cloud backend services, ensuring a robust and reliable codebase for deployment on Docker containers and CI/CD pipeline.
